objective: Train two new child-board root-policy teachers from scratch, freeze both final checkpoints before any held-out score is opened, and use prospective held-out, sealed, production-student, direct-play, and external-calibration gates instead of the closed v3 in-sample all-pairs sentinel.
claim_boundary: Phase 1 produces only two frozen offline teacher checkpoints. Tune passage authorizes only sealed evaluation. Sealed passage authorizes only the separately preregistered root-policy student/runtime lane. Formal direct-play superiority and external calibration remain mandatory before any strength, rank, live-weight, or deployment claim.

v3_result.role: spent design evidence only; the high in-sample top1 and low regret alongside sub-0.98 pair accuracy motivate moving authority to unseen and direct-play gates, but do not admit, rescue, resume, or continue v3

closed_lanes: Capacity v1, objective-only v2, and child-board capacity v3 are permanently closed.
Never load, resume, average, distill, quantize, or otherwise reuse a v3 checkpoint, optimizer state, RNG state, sentinel curve, or discarded weight.
Never rerun the v3 sentinel, extend its epochs, relax its 0.98 gate, or relabel this strength-candidate lane as a v3 continuation.
Never train, select an epoch, alter a threshold, add a seed, or change the student/runtime plan after a tune or sealed score is opened.
Never put the large child-board teacher into the production leaf-evaluation or transposition-table value path.

allowed_design_evidence: the fixed v1, v2, and v3 sentinel result receipts
the already preregistered v3 inputs, authenticated partitions, architecture, objective, training recipe, tune gate, sealed gate, formal A/B, and external calibration contracts
forbidden_design_evidence: any seed-42 or seed-314159 strength-candidate tune score
any strength-candidate sealed teacher label or candidate score
any direct A/B or external-calibration outcome
design_firewall.one_shot_rule: All thresholds and branches in this file are fixed before phase-1 optimizer creation. Once any protected result is opened, no retraining, new candidate, alternate seed, checkpoint shopping, threshold change, or minor retry is permitted.

live_nnue.role: frozen exact production child-score anchor; never trainable or writable

browser_training.role: all rules-complete legal moves independently depth-12 rescored

v9_training.role: depth-14 proposal plus independently depth-16-rescored played move

architecture.parent_input: side-to-move-normalized 28 piece occupancy planes, 14 physically normalized hand-count planes, and one clipped exact-ply plane
architecture.child_input: for each valid legal move, the authenticated child_sfen encoded with the identical side-to-move-normalized 28 piece occupancy planes, 14 physically normalized hand-count planes, and one clipped exact-ply plane; padded moves are never encoded
architecture.child_transition_contract: child_sfen must remain byte/semantic consistent with child_sfen_after_usi(parent_sfen, move) and child_position_id before optimizer creation; it is a deterministic view of registered input rows, not a new data source or label
architecture.state_encoder: 64-channel stem, six residual blocks, flattened 384-dimensional global state
architecture.child_board_encoder: one shared trainable Conv2d 43 to 16, 3x3, padding 1, no bias; GroupNorm 4 and GELU; two 16-channel residual blocks with two bias-free 3x3 convolutions and GroupNorm 4 per block; flatten 16x9x9; Linear 1296 to 128; LayerNorm 128
architecture.move_encoder: the unchanged 721-dimensional v2 parent, source/destination, explicit move-category, and frozen exact live-CP features concatenated with the 128-dimensional child-board vector; Linear 849 to 256 and unchanged LayerNorm/GELU
architecture.legal_move_set: four permutation-equivariant Transformer encoder layers, d_model 256, eight heads, FFN 1024, padding mask, no positional embedding
architecture.outputs: unclipped unquantized learned policy residual added to the frozen exact live CP anchor, plus an offline parent value
architecture.initialization: initialize every parameter independently from scratch under phase seed 42 or 314159; preserve the registered reset rules including zero initialization of final policy and state-value output layers; never load v1, v2, v3, or inter-seed weights
architecture.production_constraints: none; this is a capacity diagnostic and cannot be loaded by the browser

architecture_binding.tensor_shape_and_forward_semantics: byte-exact with the registered v3 child16x2 architecture
architecture_binding.only_identity_change: new lane schema and model_variant distinguish newly initialized strength-candidate weights from closed v3 weights
architecture_binding.production_role: offline root-policy teacher only; not a production leaf evaluator

loss.parent_weighting: Browser and V9 remain separate padded microbatches. Listwise, tie-aware hardest-negative margin, and move-value terms contribute one equal value per parent; the pair term is microaveraged over all eligible ordered pairs inside each domain microbatch.
loss.listwise: teacher relative CP clamped to [-2000,0], softmax temperature 100 CP, equal-parent mean, weight 1.0
loss.pair: all ordered teacher gaps at least 50 CP, logistic softplus, microaverage across all eligible ordered pairs in the current Browser or V9 domain microbatch, weight 1.0
loss.tie_aware_hardest_negative_margin: teacher-max ties form the complete best set and are excluded from negatives; compare max predicted CP within that best set against max predicted CP among all non-best legal moves, apply ReLU(50 CP - (best-set predicted max - non-best predicted max)) / 100 CP, equal-parent mean, weight 1.0; a parent with no non-best move contributes exact zero
loss.move_value: SmoothL1 of predicted and teacher move CP clamped to +/-3000 and scaled by 600, beta 0.25, equal-parent mean, weight 0.20
loss.state_value: same v1 parent-value target and scaling, weight 0.0; the state-value head remains architecturally present but this objective supplies it no direct loss

sentinel_bypass_authorization.reason: v3 demonstrated that the in-sample all-pairs 0.98 check can reject checkpoints with 95.31/97.17 percent top1 and 4.25/2.00 CP regret; this lane does not reinterpret that v3 verdict and instead prospectively moves admission authority to unseen data and direct play

phase1_training.status_boundary: ends after both final checkpoint hashes and receipts are fixed; tune and sealed scoring remain locked
phase1_training.runner_invocation: one logical invocation and one MPS process executes seed 42 through its frozen final checkpoint, then unconditionally executes seed 314159 through its frozen final checkpoint, then emits one terminal phase-1 result binding both hashes; a process restart is allowed only by the exact technical-crash recovery contract below

output_directory_policy.preexisting_directory: STOP unless it contains the unique incomplete run and exact latest atomic epoch checkpoint accepted by technical_crash_recovery

technical_crash_recovery.purpose: continue the same preregistered fit-only run after a ChatGPT, host, runner, or MPS process crash without opening tune or creating a statistically selectable retry
technical_crash_recovery.checkpoint_cadence: atomically replace the unique last-completed-epoch checkpoint after every completed V9 pretrain or mixed-fit epoch
technical_crash_recovery.resume_source: the unique latest valid atomic checkpoint under the fixed output_path only
technical_crash_recovery.validation_before_resume: exactly match the fixed resolved output path, protocol bytes and SHA-256, fit-only data receipt, model and optimizer schemas, seed, phase, last completed epoch, and all stored RNG states before optimizer creation or any protected-data read
technical_crash_recovery.continuation_point: the epoch immediately after the recorded last completed epoch
forbidden: a second output directory or alternate path
starting the same seed again from scratch
choosing among two or more checkpoints or attempts
resuming from an older epoch than the unique latest valid checkpoint
rolling back or replaying a completed epoch
continuing from a partially written or unverifiable checkpoint
retrying after the terminal complete phase-1 result exists
opening tune, sealed, sentinel, or candidate scores before recovery

phase1_training.initialization: independent full scratch initialization for every parameter; no v1/v2/v3 or inter-seed weight, optimizer, scheduler, RNG, gradient, or checkpoint reuse
phase1_training.mixed_parent_ratio: every Browser fit parent exactly once and exactly three rotating V9 fit parents per Browser parent per epoch
phase1_training.checkpoint_resume: only the exact latest-epoch technical-crash recovery defined above; no candidate retry or checkpoint selection

before_open_requirements: both phase-1 final checkpoint hashes are fixed
phase-1 result records zero tune or sealed access
a separate student/runtime protocol core is merged to public main and its exact Git/path/bytes/SHA identity is fixed

the student/runtime core binds both teacher checkpoint hashes, a fit-only distillation or quantization recipe, fixed-final student selection, runtime parity, latency, direct-play role, and fail-closed gates
the fit-only student recipe has completed and the exact final student artifact hash is fixed without tune or sealed access

student_runtime_protocol_core.merge_timing: after both teacher checkpoint hashes freeze and before any tune candidate score is computed or displayed
student_runtime_protocol_core.production_role: root move ordering only; live NNUE remains the leaf evaluator

tune_lock.scoring_policy: open both tune domains exactly once for both frozen teacher checkpoints and the frozen production student under one bound evaluator invocation
forbidden_after_open: selecting a checkpoint or seed by tune score
changing any tune or sealed threshold

browser_tune.mean_regret: must not exceed the registered exact live baseline

tune_gates.seed_policy: seed 42, seed 314159, and the frozen production student must independently pass every existing capacity-tune check and every V9 overlay check
tune_gates.seed_selection: none; seed 42 is preregistered as the later distillation teacher and seed 314159 is replication evidence only
tune_gates.any_miss: close the lane before sealed labels, student artifact admission, direct A/B, external calibration, or live change

clean_derivative.policy: drop an entire source game if any parent or rules-complete legal child semantic ID intersects the preregistered known-eval union; preserve surviving raw lines byte-for-byte

teacher_after_candidate_freeze.selection: sort each clean parent by sha256('capacity-sealed-v1:' + parent_id), take at most four per game, then take the lowest 512 globally
teacher_after_candidate_freeze.labels: enumerate every rules-complete legal move and independently rescore each child with the pinned YaneuraOu depth-12 teacher used by the Browser dataset
teacher_after_candidate_freeze.parallelism: independent parent shards may run in parallel after both capacity seeds pass

open_requirements: both frozen teachers and the frozen production student pass every tune and overlay check
both teacher checkpoint hashes and the student artifact hash remain unchanged
the student/runtime protocol core identity remains the exact pre-tune merged identity
sealed_gate.scoring_policy: generate the registered 512-parent all-legal teacher labels once and evaluate both frozen teacher checkpoints and the already frozen production student without retraining
sealed_gate.seed_policy: both teacher seeds and the production student must pass every existing sealed check independently
sealed_gate.auxiliary_metrics: may be reported but cannot override, weaken, or rescue the registered gate
sealed_gate.any_miss: close before student promotion, runtime integration, direct A/B, external calibration, or live change

student_runtime_boundary.production_student_role: a separately preregistered parent-plus-move-plus-child root-ordering module; never a leaf evaluator
student_runtime_boundary.student_training_data: fit-only teacher outputs; tune and sealed labels are forbidden
student_runtime_boundary.student_checkpoint_selection: fixed final checkpoint declared in the separate pre-tune protocol core and frozen before the one-shot tune opening
student_runtime_boundary.admission: the student must satisfy its preregistered parity, latency, tune, sealed, and no-leaf-value-contamination checks before direct A/B enrollment
student_runtime_boundary.no_automatic_authority: teacher tune or sealed passage alone does not authorize student training results, direct play, production enrollment, or live change

formal_direct_ab.candidate: the admitted root-ordering student, with the exact live NNUE still used for leaf evaluation
formal_direct_ab.stable: the current production engine and root ordering
formal_direct_ab.analyzable_only_if: exactly 384 complete pairs and 768 games with zero technical faults
formal_direct_ab.safety_gate: one-sided 95 percent lower bound strictly above 0.45
formal_direct_ab.stronger_claim_gate: two-sided 95 percent lower bound strictly above 0.50
formal_direct_ab.external_calibration_authority: requires the stronger-claim gate; the safety gate alone is insufficient
formal_direct_ab.partial_or_faulted_result: cannot authorize a strength claim, external calibration, production change, or retry selected after result unblinding

external_calibration.open_requirement: formal direct A/B stronger-claim gate passes and the exact student/runtime candidate is committed to public main before game 1
external_calibration.primary_decision: post-game rating must be at least 2050 after every game 171 through 200
external_calibration.claim_boundary: this exact candidate maintained the preregistered 81Dojo five-dan threshold under this account, hardware, client, time control, and pairing protocol only

staged_authority.pass: both scratch final checkpoint hashes freeze with no tune or sealed access
staged_authority.authorizes_only: merge of the separate student/runtime protocol core

staged_authority.pass: student/runtime core is publicly merged, its fit-only student artifact is frozen, and both teachers plus the student pass the one-shot tune plus overlay gates
staged_authority.authorizes_only: registered sealed-512 teacher generation and evaluation

staged_authority.pass: both teachers and the already frozen student pass every sealed-512 check
staged_authority.authorizes_only: execution of the already fixed student runtime parity and latency gates

staged_authority.pass: student parity, latency, one-shot tune, sealed, and no-leaf-contamination gates pass
formal A/B two-sided 95 percent lower bound is strictly above 0.50 with zero faults
all 200 external games complete and every post-game rating for games 171 through 200 is at least 2050
staged_authority.authorizes_only: the bounded external-calibration claim; live activation still requires a separate rollback and staged-live protocol

failure_conditions: STOP before optimizer creation on any protocol, input, data receipt, architecture, parameter-count, objective, split, source-role, or protected-union drift.
STOP if either seed is not a fresh independent initialization or if any v1/v2/v3 state is loaded.
STOP phase 1 if either fixed training schedule does not complete exactly through mixed epoch 12; do not open tune.
STOP before tune unless both checkpoint hashes and the separately merged student/runtime core are fixed.
STOP on any tune or V9 overlay miss; do not generate sealed labels.
STOP on any sealed miss; do not promote the already frozen student or run direct A/B.
STOP on any student parity, latency, static, contamination, or runtime fault; do not run direct A/B.
STOP on any incomplete or faulted formal run without a strength conclusion; do not begin external calibration.
STOP if the formal stronger-claim gate misses; the safety gate cannot authorize external calibration.
STOP external calibration on any missing, selected-opponent, faulted, discontinuous, or trace-mismatched game.
No phase authorizes a live write. Live weights and production leaf evaluation remain unchanged unless a later separately preregistered rollout and rollback protocol passes.
